verses.textZh: 这些日子过了，王又为所有在书珊城的人民，无论尊卑大小，在御园的院子里摆设筵席七天。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些日子过了，王又为所有在书珊城的人民，无论尊卑大小，在御园的院子里摆设筵席七天。
verses.textZhCuv: 这日子满了，又为所有住书珊城的大小人民在御园的院子里设摆筵席七日。

verses.textEnNkjv: Now the young woman pleased him, and she obtained his favor; so he readily gave beauty preparations to her, besides her allowance. Then seven choice maidservants were provided for her from the king’s palace, and he moved her and her maidservants to the best place in the house of the women.
verses.textEnNlt: Hegai was very impressed with Esther and treated her kindly. He quickly ordered a special menu for her and provided her with beauty treatments. He also assigned her seven maids specially chosen from the king’s palace, and he moved her and her maids into the best place in the harem.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the young lady pleased him and found favor with him. So he quickly provided her with her cosmetics and food, gave her seven choice female attendants from the king’s palace, and transferred her and her attendants to the best place in the harem.
verses.textEn: She pleased him and won his favor. Immediately he provided her with her beauty treatments and special food. He assigned to her seven female attendants selected from the king’s palace and moved her and her attendants into the best place in the harem.

verses.textZh: 以斯帖没有把自己的种族和身世告诉人，因为末底改吩咐她不可告诉人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以斯帖没有把自己的种族和身世告诉人，因为末底改吩咐她不可告诉人。
verses.textZhCuv: 以斯帖未曾将籍贯宗族告诉人，因为末底改嘱咐她不可叫人知道。
verses.textEnNiv: Esther had not revealed her nationality and family background, because Mordecai had forbidden her to do so.
verses.textEnEsv: Esther had not made known her people or kindred, for Mordecai had commanded her not to make it known.
verses.textEnNkjv: Esther had not revealed her people or family, for Mordecai had charged her not to reveal it.
verses.textEnNlt: Esther had not told anyone of her nationality and family background, because Mordecai had directed her not to do so.
verses.textEnNasb: Esther did not reveal her people or her kindred, because Mordecai had instructed her that she was not to reveal them.
verses.textEn: Esther had not revealed her nationality and family background, because Mordecai had forbidden her to do so.

verses.textZh: 末底改天天都在女院的院子前面徘徊，要知道以斯帖平安不平安，她的情形怎样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 末底改天天都在女院的院子前面徘徊，要知道以斯帖平安不平安，她的情形怎样。
verses.textZhCuv: 末底改天天在女院前边行走，要知道以斯帖平安不平安，并后事如何。
verses.textEnNiv: Every day he walked back and forth near the courtyard of the harem to find out how Esther was and what was happening to her.
verses.textEnEsv: And every day Mordecai walked in front of the court of the harem to learn how Esther was and what was happening to her.
verses.textEnNkjv: And every day Mordecai paced in front of the court of the women’s quarters, to learn of Esther’s welfare and what was happening to her.
verses.textEnNlt: Every day Mordecai would take a walk near the courtyard of the harem to find out about Esther and what was happening to her.
verses.textEnNasb: And every day Mordecai walked back and forth in front of the courtyard of the harem to learn how Esther was and what was happening to her.
verses.textEn: Every day he walked back and forth near the courtyard of the harem to find out how Esther was and what was happening to her.

verses.textZh: 每个少女轮流进宫见亚哈随鲁王之前，都要照着女子的规例洁净身体十二个月，因为女子洁身的规例是这样：六个月用没药油，六个月用香品和妇女洁身用的其他物品。
verses.textZhCnvs: 每个少女轮流进宫见亚哈随鲁王之前，都要照着女子的规例洁净身体十二个月，因为女子洁身的规例是这样：六个月用没药油，六个月用香品和妇女洁身用的其他物品。
verses.textZhCuv: 众女子照例先洁净身体十二个月：六个月用没药油，六个月用香料和洁身之物。满了日期，然后挨次进去见亚哈随鲁王。
verses.textEnNiv: Before a young woman’s turn came to go in to King Xerxes, she had to complete twelve months of beauty treatments prescribed for the women, six months with oil of myrrh and six with perfumes and cosmetics.
verses.textEnEsv: Now when the turn came for each young woman to go in to King Ahasuerus, after being twelve months under the regulations for the women, since this was the regular period of their beautifying, six months with oil of myrrh and six months with spices and ointments for women—
verses.textEnNkjv: Each young woman’s turn came to go in to King Ahasuerus after she had completed twelve months’ preparation, according to the regulations for the women, for thus were the days of their preparation apportioned: six months with oil of myrrh, and six months with perfumes and preparations for beautifying women.
verses.textEnNlt: Before each young woman was taken to the king’s bed, she was given the prescribed twelve months of beauty treatments—six months with oil of myrrh, followed by six months with special perfumes and ointments.
verses.textEnNasb: Now when the turn came for each young woman to go in to King Ahasuerus, after the end of her twelve months under the regulations for the women—for the days of their beauty treatment were completed as follows: six months with oil of myrrh and six months with balsam oil and the cosmetics for women—
verses.textEn: Before a young woman’s turn came to go in to King Xerxes, she had to complete twelve months of beauty treatments prescribed for the women, six months with oil of myrrh and six with perfumes and cosmetics.

verses.textZh: 那时，少女进去见王是这样的：从女院到王宫的时候，她所要的都要给她。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，少女进去见王是这样的：从女院到王宫的时候，她所要的都要给她。
verses.textZhCuv: 女子进去见王是这样：从女院到王宫的时候，凡她所要的都必给她。
verses.textEnNiv: And this is how she would go to the king: Anything she wanted was given her to take with her from the harem to the king’s palace.
verses.textEnEsv: when the young woman went in to the king in this way, she was given whatever she desired to take with her from the harem to the king’s palace.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus prepared, each young woman went to the king, and she was given whatever she desired to take with her from the women’s quarters to the king’s palace.
verses.textEnNlt: When it was time for her to go to the king’s palace, she was given her choice of whatever clothing or jewelry she wanted to take from the harem.
verses.textEnNasb: the young woman would go in to the king in this way: anything that she desired was given her to take with her from the harem to the king’s palace.
verses.textEn: And this is how she would go to the king: Anything she wanted was given her to take with her from the harem to the king’s palace.

verses.textZh: 她晚上进去，次日早晨回到第二女院去，交给管理妃嫔的沙甲，就是王的太监；除非王喜悦她，题名召她，她就不再进去见王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 她晚上进去，次日早晨回到第二女院去，交给管理妃嫔的沙甲，就是王的太监；除非王喜悦她，题名召她，她就不再进去见王。
verses.textZhCuv: 晚上进去，次日回到女子第二院，交给掌管妃嫔的太监沙甲；除非王喜爱她，再提名召她，就不再进去见王。
verses.textEnNiv: In the evening she would go there and in the morning return to another part of the harem to the care of Shaashgaz, the king’s eunuch who was in charge of the concubines. She would not return to the king unless he was pleased with her and summoned her by name.
verses.textEnEsv: In the evening she would go in, and in the morning she would return to the second harem in custody of Shaashgaz, the king’s eunuch, who was in charge of the concubines. She would not go in to the king again, unless the king delighted in her and she was summoned by name.
verses.textEnNkjv: In the evening she went, and in the morning she returned to the second house of the women, to the custody of Shaashgaz, the king’s eunuch who kept the concubines. She would not go in to the king again unless the king delighted in her and called for her by name.
verses.textEnNlt: That evening she was taken to the king’s private rooms, and the next morning she was brought to the second harem, where the king’s wives lived. There she would be under the care of Shaashgaz, the king’s eunuch in charge of the concubines. She would never go to the king again unless he had especially enjoyed her and requested her by name.
verses.textEnNasb: In the evening she would enter and in the morning she would return to the second harem, to the custody of Shaashgaz, the king’s eunuch who was in charge of the concubines. She would not go in to the king again, unless the king delighted in her and she was summoned by name.
verses.textEn: In the evening she would go there and in the morning return to another part of the harem to the care of Shaashgaz, the king’s eunuch who was in charge of the concubines. She would not return to the king unless he was pleased with her and summoned her by name.

verses.textZh: 末底改的叔叔亚比孩的女儿以斯帖，就是末底改收养作自己女儿的，轮到她进去见王的时候，除了王的太监，掌理女子的希该所预备的以外，以斯帖别无所求；看见以斯帖的，都喜爱她。
verses.textZhCnvs: 末底改的叔叔亚比孩的女儿以斯帖，就是末底改收养作自己女儿的，轮到她进去见王的时候，除了王的太监，掌理女子的希该所预备的以外，以斯帖别无所求；看见以斯帖的，都喜爱她。
verses.textZhCuv: 末底改叔叔亚比孩的女儿，就是末底改收为自己女儿的以斯帖，按次序当进去见王的时候，除了掌管女子的太监希该所派定给她的，她别无所求。凡看见以斯帖的都喜悦她。
verses.textEnNiv: When the turn came for Esther (the young woman Mordecai had adopted, the daughter of his uncle Abihail) to go to the king, she asked for nothing other than what Hegai, the king’s eunuch who was in charge of the harem, suggested. And Esther won the favor of everyone who saw her.
verses.textEnEsv: When the turn came for Esther the daughter of Abihail the uncle of Mordecai, who had taken her as his own daughter, to go in to the king, she asked for nothing except what Hegai the king’s eunuch, who had charge of the women, advised. Now Esther was winning favor in the eyes of all who saw her.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when the turn came for Esther the daughter of Abihail the uncle of Mordecai, who had taken her as his daughter, to go in to the king, she requested nothing but what Hegai the king’s eunuch, the custodian of the women, advised. And Esther obtained favor in the sight of all who saw her.
verses.textEnNlt: Esther was the daughter of Abihail, who was Mordecai’s uncle. (Mordecai had adopted his younger cousin Esther.) When it was Esther’s turn to go to the king, she accepted the advice of Hegai, the eunuch in charge of the harem. She asked for nothing except what he suggested, and she was admired by everyone who saw her.
verses.textEnNasb: Now when the turn of Esther, the daughter of Abihail the uncle of Mordecai who had taken her as his daughter, came to go in to the king, she did not request anything except what Hegai, the king’s eunuch who was in charge of the women, advised. And Esther was finding favor in the eyes of all who saw her.
verses.textEn: When the turn came for Esther (the young woman Mordecai had adopted, the daughter of his uncle Abihail) to go to the king, she asked for nothing other than what Hegai, the king’s eunuch who was in charge of the harem, suggested. And Esther won the favor of everyone who saw her.

verses.textZh: 亚哈随鲁王执政第七年十月，就是提别月，以斯帖被带进王宫去见亚哈随鲁王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚哈随鲁王执政第七年十月，就是提别月，以斯帖被带进王宫去见亚哈随鲁王。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚哈随鲁王第七年十月，就是提别月，以斯帖被引入宫见王。
verses.textEnNiv: She was taken to King Xerxes in the royal residence in the tenth month, the month of Tebeth, in the seventh year of his reign.
verses.textEnEsv: And when Esther was taken to King Ahasuerus, into his royal palace, in the tenth month, which is the month of Tebeth, in the seventh year of his reign,
verses.textEnNkjv: So Esther was taken to King Ahasuerus, into his royal palace, in the tenth month, which is the month of Tebeth, in the seventh year of his reign.
verses.textEnNlt: Esther was taken to King Xerxes at the royal palace in early winter of the seventh year of his reign.
verses.textEnNasb: So Esther was taken to King Ahasuerus in his royal palace in the tenth month, which is the month Tebeth, in the seventh year of his reign.
verses.textEn: She was taken to King Xerxes in the royal residence in the tenth month, the month of Tebeth, in the seventh year of his reign.

verses.textZh: 王爱以斯帖超过所有其他的女子；在所有的处女中，她在王的面前，最得王的恩宠与喜爱；王把王后的冠冕戴在她头上，立她为王后，代替瓦实提。
verses.textZhCnvs: 王爱以斯帖超过所有其他的女子；在所有的处女中，她在王的面前，最得王的恩宠与喜爱；王把王后的冠冕戴在她头上，立她为王后，代替瓦实提。
verses.textZhCuv: 王爱以斯帖过于爱众女，她在王眼前蒙宠爱比众处女更甚。王就把王后的冠冕戴在她头上，立她为王后，代替瓦实提。
verses.textEnNiv: Now the king was attracted to Esther more than to any of the other women, and she won his favor and approval more than any of the other virgins. So he set a royal crown on her head and made her queen instead of Vashti.
verses.textEnEsv: the king loved Esther more than all the women, and she won grace and favor in his sight more than all the virgins, so that he set the royal crown on her head and made her queen instead of Vashti.
verses.textEnNkjv: The king loved Esther more than all the other women, and she obtained grace and favor in his sight more than all the virgins; so he set the royal crown upon her head and made her queen instead of Vashti.
verses.textEnNlt: And the king loved Esther more than any of the other young women. He was so delighted with her that he set the royal crown on her head and declared her queen instead of Vashti.
verses.textEnNasb: The king loved Esther more than all the women, and she found favor and kindness with him more than all the virgins, so that he set the royal turban on her head and made her queen in place of Vashti.
verses.textEn: Now the king was attracted to Esther more than to any of the other women, and she won his favor and approval more than any of the other virgins. So he set a royal crown on her head and made her queen instead of Vashti.

verses.textZh: 王为他的文武百官大摆筵席，就是以斯帖的婚筵，又向各省颁布休假一天，并且照着王的厚意，颁赐礼物。
verses.textZhCnvs: 王为他的文武百官大摆筵席，就是以斯帖的婚筵，又向各省颁布休假一天，并且照着王的厚意，颁赐礼物。
verses.textZhCuv: 王因以斯帖的缘故给众首领和臣仆设摆大筵席，又豁免各省的租税，并照王的厚意大颁赏赐。
verses.textEnNiv: And the king gave a great banquet, Esther’s banquet, for all his nobles and officials. He proclaimed a holiday throughout the provinces and distributed gifts with royal liberality.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the king gave a great feast for all his officials and servants; it was Esther’s feast. He also granted a remission of taxes to the provinces and gave gifts with royal generosity.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the king made a great feast, the Feast of Esther, for all his officials and servants; and he proclaimed a holiday in the provinces and gave gifts according to the generosity of a king.
verses.textEnNlt: To celebrate the occasion, he gave a great banquet in Esther’s honor for all his nobles and officials, declaring a public holiday for the provinces and giving generous gifts to everyone.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the king held a great banquet, Esther’s banquet, for all his officials and his servants; he also made a holiday for the provinces and gave gifts in proportion to the king’s bounty.
verses.textEn: And the king gave a great banquet, Esther’s banquet, for all his nobles and officials. He proclaimed a holiday throughout the provinces and distributed gifts with royal liberality.

verses.textZh: 第二次召集处女的时候，末底改坐在朝门那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 第二次召集处女的时候，末底改坐在朝门那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 第二次招聚处女的时候，末底改坐在朝门。
verses.textEnNiv: When the virgins were assembled a second time, Mordecai was sitting at the king’s gate.
verses.textEnEsv: Now when the virgins were gathered together the second time, Mordecai was sitting at the king’s gate.
verses.textEnNkjv: When virgins were gathered together a second time, Mordecai sat within the king’s gate.
verses.textEnNlt: Even after all the young women had been transferred to the second harem and Mordecai had become a palace official,
verses.textEnNasb: Now when the virgins were gathered together for the second time, then Mordecai was sitting at the king’s gate.
verses.textEn: When the virgins were assembled a second time, Mordecai was sitting at the king’s gate.

verses.textZh: 以斯帖照着末底改吩咐她的，没有把自己的身世和种族告诉人；末底改所说的话，以斯帖都遵行，就像昔日养育她的时候一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以斯帖照着末底改吩咐她的，没有把自己的身世和种族告诉人；末底改所说的话，以斯帖都遵行，就像昔日养育她的时候一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 以斯帖照着末底改所嘱咐的，还没有将籍贯宗族告诉人；因为以斯帖遵末底改的命，如抚养她的时候一样。
verses.textEnNiv: But Esther had kept secret her family background and nationality just as Mordecai had told her to do, for she continued to follow Mordecai’s instructions as she had done when he was bringing her up.
verses.textEnEsv: Esther had not made known her kindred or her people, as Mordecai had commanded her, for Esther obeyed Mordecai just as when she was brought up by him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Esther had not revealed her family and her people, just as Mordecai had charged her, for Esther obeyed the command of Mordecai as when she was brought up by him.
verses.textEnNlt: Esther continued to keep her family background and nationality a secret. She was still following Mordecai’s directions, just as she did when she lived in his home.
verses.textEnNasb: Esther still had not revealed her relatives or her people, just as Mordecai had instructed her; for Esther did what Mordecai told her just as she had when under his care.
verses.textEn: But Esther had kept secret her family background and nationality just as Mordecai had told her to do, for she continued to follow Mordecai’s instructions as she had done when he was bringing her up.

verses.textZh: 那时，末底改坐在朝门那里，王有两个守门的太监：辟探和提列，一时因为恼怒，正想下手害亚哈随鲁王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，末底改坐在朝门那里，王有两个守门的太监：辟探和提列，一时因为恼怒，正想下手害亚哈随鲁王。
verses.textZhCuv: 当那时候，末底改坐在朝门，王的太监中有两个守门的，辟探和提列，恼恨亚哈随鲁王，想要下手害他。
verses.textEnNiv: During the time Mordecai was sitting at the king’s gate, Bigthana and Teresh, two of the king’s officers who guarded the doorway, became angry and conspired to assassinate King Xerxes.
verses.textEnEsv: In those days, as Mordecai was sitting at the king’s gate, Bigthan and Teresh, two of the king’s eunuchs, who guarded the threshold, became angry and sought to lay hands on King Ahasuerus.
verses.textEnNkjv: In those days, while Mordecai sat within the king’s gate, two of the king’s eunuchs, Bigthan and Teresh, doorkeepers, became furious and sought to lay hands on King Ahasuerus.
verses.textEnNlt: One day as Mordecai was on duty at the king’s gate, two of the king’s eunuchs, Bigthana and Teresh—who were guards at the door of the king’s private quarters—became angry at King Xerxes and plotted to assassinate him.
verses.textEnNasb: In those days, while Mordecai was sitting at the king’s gate, Bigthan and Teresh, two of the king’s officials from those who guarded the door, became angry and sought to attack King Ahasuerus.
verses.textEn: During the time Mordecai was sitting at the king’s gate, Bigthana and Teresh, two of the king’s officers who guarded the doorway, became angry and conspired to assassinate King Xerxes.

verses.textZh: 这阴谋给末底改知道了，他就告诉王后以斯帖；以斯帖就以末底改的名义对王说起这事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这阴谋给末底改知道了，他就告诉王后以斯帖；以斯帖就以末底改的名义对王说起这事。
verses.textZhCuv: 末底改知道了，就告诉王后以斯帖。以斯帖奉末底改的名，报告于王；
verses.textEnNiv: But Mordecai found out about the plot and told Queen Esther, who in turn reported it to the king, giving credit to Mordecai.
verses.textEnEsv: And this came to the knowledge of Mordecai, and he told it to Queen Esther, and Esther told the king in the name of Mordecai.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the matter became known to Mordecai, who told Queen Esther, and Esther informed the king in Mordecai’s name.
verses.textEnNlt: But Mordecai heard about the plot and gave the information to Queen Esther. She then told the king about it and gave Mordecai credit for the report.
verses.textEnNasb: But the plot became known to Mordecai and he informed Queen Esther, and Esther told the king in Mordecai’s name.
verses.textEn: But Mordecai found out about the plot and told Queen Esther, who in turn reported it to the king, giving credit to Mordecai.

verses.textZh: 那阴谋查究起来，就发现真相；于是把二人悬挂在木架上。这事在王面前曾写于史记。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那阴谋查究起来，就发现真相；于是把二人悬挂在木架上。这事在王面前曾写于史记。
verses.textZhCuv: 究察这事，果然是实，就把二人挂在木头上，将这事在王面前写于历史上。
verses.textEnNiv: And when the report was investigated and found to be true, the two officials were impaled on poles. All this was recorded in the book of the annals in the presence of the king.
verses.textEnEsv: When the affair was investigated and found to be so, the men were both hanged on the gallows. And it was recorded in the book of the chronicles in the presence of the king.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when an inquiry was made into the matter, it was confirmed, and both were hanged on a gallows; and it was written in the book of the chronicles in the presence of the king.
verses.textEnNlt: When an investigation was made and Mordecai’s story was found to be true, the two men were impaled on a sharpened pole. This was all recorded in The Book of the History of King Xerxes’ Reign.
verses.textEnNasb: Then when the plot was investigated and found to be so, they were both hanged on a wooden gallows; and it was written in the Book of the Chronicles in the king’s presence.
verses.textEn: And when the report was investigated and found to be true, the two officials were impaled on poles. All this was recorded in the book of the annals in the presence of the king.

verses.textZh: 这事以后，亚哈随鲁王使亚甲族哈米大他的儿子哈曼晋升；王提拔他，使他的地位高过所有与他在一起的大臣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这事以后，亚哈随鲁王使亚甲族哈米大他的儿子哈曼晋升；王提拔他，使他的地位高过所有与他在一起的大臣。
verses.textZhCuv: 这事以后，亚哈随鲁王抬举亚甲族哈米大他的儿子哈曼，使他高升，叫他的爵位超过与他同事的一切臣宰。
verses.textEnNiv: After these events, King Xerxes honored Haman son of Hammedatha, the Agagite, elevating him and giving him a seat of honor higher than that of all the other nobles.
verses.textEnEsv: After these things King Ahasuerus promoted Haman the Agagite, the son of Hammedatha, and advanced him and set his throne above all the officials who were with him.
verses.textEnNkjv: After these things King Ahasuerus promoted Haman, the son of Hammedatha the Agagite, and advanced him and set his seat above all the princes who were with him.
verses.textEnNlt: Some time later King Xerxes promoted Haman son of Hammedatha the Agagite over all the other nobles, making him the most powerful official in the empire.
verses.textEnNasb: After these events King Ahasuerus honored Haman, the son of Hammedatha the Agagite, and promoted him and established his authority over all the officials who were with him.
verses.textEn: After these events, King Xerxes honored Haman son of Hammedatha, the Agagite, elevating him and giving him a seat of honor higher than that of all the other nobles.

verses.textZh: 在朝门那里，王的所有臣仆，都向哈曼屈身下拜，因为王曾经这样吩咐；只有末底改不跪，也不拜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在朝门那里，王的所有臣仆，都向哈曼屈身下拜，因为王曾经这样吩咐；只有末底改不跪，也不拜。
verses.textZhCuv: 在朝门的一切臣仆都跪拜哈曼，因为王如此吩咐；惟独末底改不跪不拜。
verses.textEnNiv: All the royal officials at the king’s gate knelt down and paid honor to Haman, for the king had commanded this concerning him. But Mordecai would not kneel down or pay him honor.
verses.textEnEsv: And all the king’s servants who were at the king’s gate bowed down and paid homage to Haman, for the king had so commanded concerning him. But Mordecai did not bow down or pay homage.
verses.textEnNkjv: And all the king’s servants who were within the king’s gate bowed and paid homage to Haman, for so the king had commanded concerning him. But Mordecai would not bow or pay homage.
verses.textEnNlt: All the king’s officials would bow down before Haman to show him respect whenever he passed by, for so the king had commanded. But Mordecai refused to bow down or show him respect.
verses.textEnNasb: All the king’s servants who were at the king’s gate bowed down and paid homage to Haman; for so the king had commanded regarding him. But Mordecai neither bowed down nor paid homage.
verses.textEn: All the royal officials at the king’s gate knelt down and paid honor to Haman, for the king had commanded this concerning him. But Mordecai would not kneel down or pay him honor.

verses.textZh: 于是在朝门的臣仆问末底改："你为甚么违背王的命令呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是在朝门的臣仆问末底改："你为甚么违背王的命令呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 在朝门的臣仆问末底改说：「你为何违背王的命令呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: Then the royal officials at the king’s gate asked Mordecai, "Why do you disobey the king’s command?"
verses.textEnEsv: Then the king’s servants who were at the king’s gate said to Mordecai, "Why do you transgress the king’s command?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the king’s servants who were within the king’s gate said to Mordecai, "Why do you transgress the king’s command?"
verses.textEnNlt: Then the palace officials at the king’s gate asked Mordecai, "Why are you disobeying the king’s command?"
verses.textEnNasb: Then the king’s servants who were at the king’s gate said to Mordecai, "Why are you violating the king’s command?"
verses.textEn: Then the royal officials at the king’s gate asked Mordecai, "Why do you disobey the king’s command?"

verses.textZh: 他们天天劝他，他还是不听，他们就告诉哈曼，要看看末底改的话是不是坚持到底，因为他已经告诉他们，他自己是犹大人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们天天劝他，他还是不听，他们就告诉哈曼，要看看末底改的话是不是坚持到底，因为他已经告诉他们，他自己是犹大人。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们天天劝他，他还是不听，他们就告诉哈曼，要看末底改的事站得住站不住，因他已经告诉他们自己是犹大人。
verses.textEnNiv: Day after day they spoke to him but he refused to comply. Therefore they told Haman about it to see whether Mordecai’s behavior would be tolerated, for he had told them he was a Jew.
verses.textEnEsv: And when they spoke to him day after day and he would not listen to them, they told Haman, in order to see whether Mordecai’s words would stand, for he had told them that he was a Jew.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it happened, when they spoke to him daily and he would not listen to them, that they told it to Haman, to see whether Mordecai’s words would stand; for Mordecai had told them that he was a Jew.
verses.textEnNlt: They spoke to him day after day, but still he refused to comply with the order. So they spoke to Haman about this to see if he would tolerate Mordecai’s conduct, since Mordecai had told them he was a Jew.
verses.textEnNasb: Now it was when they had spoken daily to him and he would not listen to them, that they told Haman to see whether Mordecai’s reason would stand; for he had told them that he was a Jew.
verses.textEn: Day after day they spoke to him but he refused to comply. Therefore they told Haman about it to see whether Mordecai’s behavior would be tolerated, for he had told them he was a Jew.

verses.textZh: 哈曼见末底改不向他屈身下拜，就非常忿怒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 哈曼见末底改不向他屈身下拜，就非常忿怒。
verses.textZhCuv: 哈曼见末底改不跪不拜，他就怒气填胸。
verses.textEnNiv: When Haman saw that Mordecai would not kneel down or pay him honor, he was enraged.
verses.textEnEsv: And when Haman saw that Mordecai did not bow down or pay homage to him, Haman was filled with fury.
verses.textEnNkjv: When Haman saw that Mordecai did not bow or pay him homage, Haman was filled with wrath.
verses.textEnNlt: When Haman saw that Mordecai would not bow down or show him respect, he was filled with rage.
verses.textEnNasb: When Haman saw that Mordecai neither bowed down nor paid homage to him, Haman was filled with rage.
verses.textEn: When Haman saw that Mordecai would not kneel down or pay him honor, he was enraged.

verses.textZh: 他以为只下手对付末底改一人还是小事，因为有人把末底改的本族告诉了哈曼；所以哈曼设法要把亚哈随鲁王全国所有的犹大人，与末底改一起消灭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他以为只下手对付末底改一人还是小事，因为有人把末底改的本族告诉了哈曼；所以哈曼设法要把亚哈随鲁王全国所有的犹大人，与末底改一起消灭。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们已将末底改的本族告诉哈曼；他以为下手害末底改一人是小事，就要灭绝亚哈随鲁王通国所有的犹大人，就是末底改的本族。
verses.textEnNiv: Yet having learned who Mordecai’s people were, he scorned the idea of killing only Mordecai. Instead Haman looked for a way to destroy all Mordecai’s people, the Jews, throughout the whole kingdom of Xerxes.
verses.textEnEsv: But he disdained to lay hands on Mordecai alone. So, as they had made known to him the people of Mordecai, Haman sought to destroy all the Jews, the people of Mordecai, throughout the whole kingdom of Ahasuerus.
verses.textEnNkjv: But he disdained to lay hands on Mordecai alone, for they had told him of the people of Mordecai. Instead, Haman sought to destroy all the Jews who were throughout the whole kingdom of Ahasuerus—the people of Mordecai.
verses.textEnNlt: He had learned of Mordecai’s nationality, so he decided it was not enough to lay hands on Mordecai alone. Instead, he looked for a way to destroy all the Jews throughout the entire empire of Xerxes.
verses.textEnNasb: But he considered it beneath his dignity to kill Mordecai alone, for they had told him who the people of Mordecai were; so Haman sought to annihilate all the Jews, the people of Mordecai, who were found throughout the kingdom of Ahasuerus.
verses.textEn: Yet having learned who Mordecai’s people were, he scorned the idea of killing only Mordecai. Instead Haman looked for a way to destroy all Mordecai’s people, the Jews, throughout the whole kingdom of Xerxes.

verses.textZh: 亚哈随鲁王十二年正月，就是尼散月，有人在哈曼面前弄卜"普珥"，就是抽签，逐日逐月地抽，结果抽出了十二月，就是亚达月。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚哈随鲁王十二年正月，就是尼散月，有人在哈曼面前弄卜"普珥"，就是抽签，逐日逐月地抽，结果抽出了十二月，就是亚达月。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚哈随鲁王十二年正月，就是尼散月，人在哈曼面前，按日日月月掣普珥，就是掣签，要定何月何日为吉，择定了十二月，就是亚达月。
verses.textEnNiv: In the twelfth year of King Xerxes, in the first month, the month of Nisan, the pur (that is, the lot) was cast in the presence of Haman to select a day and month. And the lot fell on the twelfth month, the month of Adar.
verses.textEnEsv: In the first month, which is the month of Nisan, in the twelfth year of King Ahasuerus, they cast Pur (that is, they cast lots) before Haman day after day; and they cast it month after month till the twelfth month, which is the month of Adar.
verses.textEnNkjv: In the first month, which is the month of Nisan, in the twelfth year of King Ahasuerus, they cast Pur (that is, the lot), before Haman to determine the day and the month, until itfellonthe twelfth month, which is the month of Adar.
verses.textEnNlt: So in the month of April, during the twelfth year of King Xerxes’ reign, lots were cast in Haman’s presence (the lots were called purim) to determine the best day and month to take action. And the day selected was March 7, nearly a year later.
verses.textEnNasb: In the first month, which is the month Nisan, in the twelfth year of King Ahasuerus, Pur, that is the lot, was cast before Haman from day to day and from month to month, until the twelfth month, that is the month Adar.
verses.textEn: In the twelfth year of King Xerxes, in the first month, the month of Nisan, the pur (that is, the lot) was cast in the presence of Haman to select a day and month. And the lot fell on the twelfth month, the month of Adar.

verses.textZh: 哈曼对亚哈随鲁王说："有一个种族，散居在王国各省各民族之中；他们的法例与各族的法例不同，他们也不遵守王的法规；所以留下他们，对王实在无益。
verses.textZhCnvs: 哈曼对亚哈随鲁王说："有一个种族，散居在王国各省各民族之中；他们的法例与各族的法例不同，他们也不遵守王的法规；所以留下他们，对王实在无益。
verses.textZhCuv: 哈曼对亚哈随鲁王说：「有一种民散居在王国各省的民中；他们的律例与万民的律例不同，也不守王的律例，所以容留他们与王无益。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Haman said to King Xerxes, "There is a certain people dispersed among the peoples in all the provinces of your kingdom who keep themselves separate. Their customs are different from those of all other people, and they do not obey the king’s laws; it is not in the king’s best interest to tolerate them.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Haman said to King Ahasuerus, "There is a certain people scattered abroad and dispersed among the peoples in all the provinces of your kingdom. Their laws are different from those of every other people, and they do not keep the king’s laws, so that it is not to the king’s profit to tolerate them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Haman said to King Ahasuerus, "There is a certain people scattered and dispersed among the people in all the provinces of your kingdom; their laws are different from all other people’s, and they do not keep the king’s laws. Therefore it is not fitting for the king to let them remain.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Haman approached King Xerxes and said, "There is a certain race of people scattered through all the provinces of your empire who keep themselves separate from everyone else. Their laws are different from those of any other people, and they refuse to obey the laws of the king. So it is not in the king’s interest to let them live.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Haman said to King Ahasuerus, "There is a certain people scattered and dispersed among the peoples in all the provinces of your kingdom; their laws are different from those of all other people and they do not comply with the king’s laws, so it is not in the king’s interest to let them remain.
verses.textEn: Then Haman said to King Xerxes, "There is a certain people dispersed among the peoples in all the provinces of your kingdom who keep themselves separate. Their customs are different from those of all other people, and they do not obey the king’s laws; it is not in the king’s best interest to tolerate them.

verses.textZh: 王若是赞成，请王降旨消灭他们；我愿捐出三十四万公斤银子，交在管理国务的人手中，纳入王库。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 王若是赞成，请王降旨消灭他们；我愿捐出三十四万公斤银子，交在管理国务的人手中，纳入王库。"
verses.textZhCuv: 王若以为美，请下旨意灭绝他们；我就捐一万他连得银子交给掌管国帑的人，纳入王的府库。」
verses.textEnNiv: If it pleases the king, let a decree be issued to destroy them, and I will give ten thousand talents of silver to the king’s administrators for the royal treasury."
verses.textEnEsv: If it please the king, let it be decreed that they be destroyed, and I will pay 10,000 talents of silver into the hands of those who have charge of the king’s business, that they may put it into the king’s treasuries."
verses.textEnNkjv: If it pleases the king, let adecree be written that they be destroyed, and I will pay ten thousand talents of silver into the hands of those who do the work, to bring it into the king’s treasuries."
verses.textEnNlt: If it please the king, issue a decree that they be destroyed, and I will give 10,000 large sacks of silver to the government administrators to be deposited in the royal treasury."
verses.textEnNasb: If it is pleasing to the king, let it be decreed that they be eliminated, and I will pay ten thousand talents of silver into the hands of those who carry out the king’s business, to put into the king’s treasuries."
verses.textEn: If it pleases the king, let a decree be issued to destroy them, and I will give ten thousand talents of silver to the king’s administrators for the royal treasury."

verses.textZh: 于是王从自己的手中取下戒指，交给犹大人的敌人，亚甲族哈米大他的儿子哈曼。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是王从自己的手中取下戒指，交给犹大人的敌人，亚甲族哈米大他的儿子哈曼。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是王从自己手上摘下戒指给犹大人的仇敌－亚甲族哈米大他的儿子哈曼。
verses.textEnNiv: So the king took his signet ring from his finger and gave it to Haman son of Hammedatha, the Agagite, the enemy of the Jews.
verses.textEnEsv: So the king took his signet ring from his hand and gave it to Haman the Agagite, the son of Hammedatha, the enemy of the Jews.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the king took his signet ring from his hand and gave it to Haman, the son of Hammedatha the Agagite, the enemy of the Jews.
verses.textEnNlt: The king agreed, confirming his decision by removing his signet ring from his finger and giving it to Haman son of Hammedatha the Agagite, the enemy of the Jews.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the king took his signet ring from his hand and gave it to Haman, the son of Hammedatha the Agagite, the enemy of the Jews.
verses.textEn: So the king took his signet ring from his finger and gave it to Haman son of Hammedatha, the Agagite, the enemy of the Jews.

verses.textZh: 王对哈曼说："这银子仍赐给你，这民也交给你，你看怎样好，就怎样待他们吧。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 王对哈曼说："这银子仍赐给你，这民也交给你，你看怎样好，就怎样待他们吧。"
verses.textZhCuv: 王对哈曼说：「这银子仍赐给你，这民也交给你，你可以随意待他们。」
verses.textEnNiv: "Keep the money," the king said to Haman, "and do with the people as you please."
verses.textEnEsv: And the king said to Haman, "The money is given to you, the people also, to do with them as it seems good to you."
verses.textEnNkjv: And the king said to Haman, "The money and the people are given to you, to do with them as seems good to you."
verses.textEnNlt: The king said, "The money and the people are both yours to do with as you see fit."
verses.textEnNasb: And the king said to Haman, "The silver is yours, and the people also, to do with them as you please."
verses.textEn: "Keep the money," the king said to Haman, "and do with the people as you please."

verses.textZh: 正月十三日，王的书记都召了来，照着哈曼的一切吩咐，用各省的文字，各族的方言，奉亚哈随鲁王的名下旨，又用王的戒指盖上印，颁给总督、各省的省长和各族的领袖。
verses.textZhCnvs: 正月十三日，王的书记都召了来，照着哈曼的一切吩咐，用各省的文字，各族的方言，奉亚哈随鲁王的名下旨，又用王的戒指盖上印，颁给总督、各省的省长和各族的领袖。
verses.textZhCuv: 正月十三日，就召了王的书记来，照着哈曼一切所吩咐的，用各省的文字、各族的方言，奉亚哈随鲁王的名写旨意，传与总督和各省的省长，并各族的首领；又用王的戒指盖印，
verses.textEnNiv: Then on the thirteenth day of the first month the royal secretaries were summoned. They wrote out in the script of each province and in the language of each people all Haman’s orders to the king’s satraps, the governors of the various provinces and the nobles of the various peoples. These were written in the name of King Xerxes himself and sealed with his own ring.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the king’s scribes were summoned on the thirteenth day of the first month, and an edict, according to all that Haman commanded, was written to the king’s satraps and to the governors over all the provinces and to the officials of all the peoples, to every province in its own script and every people in its own language. It was written in the name of King Ahasuerus and sealed with the king’s signet ring.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the king’s scribes were called on the thirteenth day of the first month, and adecree was written according to all that Haman commanded—to the king’s satraps, to the governors who were over each province, to the officials of all people, to every province according to its script, and to every people in their language. In the name of King Ahasuerus it was written, and sealed with the king’s signet ring.
verses.textEnNlt: So on April 17 the king’s secretaries were summoned, and a decree was written exactly as Haman dictated. It was sent to the king’s highest officers, the governors of the respective provinces, and the nobles of each province in their own scripts and languages. The decree was written in the name of King Xerxes and sealed with the king’s signet ring.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the king’s scribes were summoned on the thirteenth day of the first month, and it was written just as Haman commanded to the king’s satraps, to the governors who were over each province and to the officials of each people, each province according to its script, each people according to its language, being written in the name of King Ahasuerus and sealed with the king’s signet ring.
verses.textEn: Then on the thirteenth day of the first month the royal secretaries were summoned. They wrote out in the script of each province and in the language of each people all Haman’s orders to the king’s satraps, the governors of the various provinces and the nobles of the various peoples. These were written in the name of King Xerxes himself and sealed with his own ring.

verses.textZh: 王旨交给众驿使传到王的各省，吩咐要在一日之内，在十二月，就是亚达月十三日，把所有的犹大人，无论老少妇孺，都全部毁灭、杀绝、除尽，并且抢夺他们的财产。
verses.textZhCnvs: 王旨交给众驿使传到王的各省，吩咐要在一日之内，在十二月，就是亚达月十三日，把所有的犹大人，无论老少妇孺，都全部毁灭、杀绝、除尽，并且抢夺他们的财产。
verses.textZhCuv: 交给驿卒传到王的各省，吩咐将犹大人，无论老少妇女孩子，在一日之间，十二月，就是亚达月十三日，全然剪除，杀戮灭绝，并夺他们的财为掠物。
verses.textEnNiv: Dispatches were sent by couriers to all the king’s provinces with the order to destroy, kill and annihilate all the Jews—young and old, women and children—on a single day, the thirteenth day of the twelfth month, the month of Adar, and to plunder their goods.
verses.textEnEsv: Letters were sent by couriers to all the king’s provinces with instruction to destroy, to kill, and to annihilate all Jews, young and old, women and children, in one day, the thirteenth day of the twelfth month, which is the month of Adar, and to plunder their goods.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the letters were sent by couriers into all the king’s provinces, to destroy, to kill, and to annihilate all the Jews, both young and old, little children and women, in one day, on the thirteenth day of the twelfth month, which is the month of Adar, and to plunder their possessions.
verses.textEnNlt: Dispatches were sent by swift messengers into all the provinces of the empire, giving the order that all Jews—young and old, including women and children—must be killed, slaughtered, and annihilated on a single day. This was scheduled to happen on March 7 of the next year. The property of the Jews would be given to those who killed them.
verses.textEnNasb: Letters were sent by couriers to all the king’s provinces to annihilate, kill, and destroy all the Jews, both young and old, women and children, in one day, the thirteenth day of the twelfth month, which is the month Adar, and to seize their possessions as plunder.
verses.textEn: Dispatches were sent by couriers to all the king’s provinces with the order to destroy, kill and annihilate all the Jews—young and old, women and children—on a single day, the thirteenth day of the twelfth month, the month of Adar, and to plunder their goods.

verses.textZh: 谕文抄本颁行各省，通告各族，使他们准备好这一天。
verses.textZhCnvs: 谕文抄本颁行各省，通告各族，使他们准备好这一天。
verses.textZhCuv: 抄录这旨意，颁行各省，宣告各族，使他们预备等候那日。
verses.textEnNiv: A copy of the text of the edict was to be issued as law in every province and made known to the people of every nationality so they would be ready for that day.
verses.textEnEsv: A copy of the document was to be issued as a decree in every province by proclamation to all the peoples to be ready for that day.
verses.textEnNkjv: A copy of the document was to be issued as law in every province, being published for all people, that they should be ready for that day.
verses.textEnNlt: A copy of this decree was to be issued as law in every province and proclaimed to all peoples, so that they would be ready to do their duty on the appointed day.
verses.textEnNasb: A copy of the edict to be issued as law in every province was published to all the peoples so that they would be ready for this day.
verses.textEn: A copy of the text of the edict was to be issued as law in every province and made known to the people of every nationality so they would be ready for that day.

verses.textZh: 驿使奉王命急忙出发，御旨从书珊城颁布出去。那时王与哈曼又同坐共饮，书珊城的居民却非常慌乱。
verses.textZhCnvs: 驿使奉王命急忙出发，御旨从书珊城颁布出去。那时王与哈曼又同坐共饮，书珊城的居民却非常慌乱。
verses.textZhCuv: 驿卒奉王命急忙起行，旨意也传遍书珊城。王同哈曼坐下饮酒，书珊城的民却都慌乱。
verses.textEnNiv: The couriers went out, spurred on by the king’s command, and the edict was issued in the citadel of Susa. The king and Haman sat down to drink, but the city of Susa was bewildered.
verses.textEnEsv: The couriers went out hurriedly by order of the king, and the decree was issued in Susa the citadel. And the king and Haman sat down to drink, but the city of Susa was thrown into confusion.
verses.textEnNkjv: The couriers went out, hastened by the king’s command; and the decree was proclaimed in Shushan the citadel. So the king and Haman sat down to drink, but the city of Shushan was perplexed.
verses.textEnNlt: At the king’s command, the decree went out by swift messengers, and it was also proclaimed in the fortress of Susa. Then the king and Haman sat down to drink, but the city of Susa fell into confusion.
verses.textEnNasb: The couriers went out, speeded by the king’s order while the decree was issued at the citadel in Susa; and while the king and Haman sat down to drink, the city of Susa was agitated.
verses.textEn: The couriers went out, spurred on by the king’s command, and the edict was issued in the citadel of Susa. The king and Haman sat down to drink, but the city of Susa was bewildered.

verses.textZh: 末底改知道了发生的一切事，就撕裂自己的衣服，披上麻衣，撒上灰尘，出到城中，大声痛哭地呼叫。
verses.textZhCnvs: 末底改知道了发生的一切事，就撕裂自己的衣服，披上麻衣，撒上灰尘，出到城中，大声痛哭地呼叫。
verses.textZhCuv: 末底改知道所做的这一切事，就撕裂衣服，穿麻衣，蒙灰尘，在城中行走，痛哭哀号。
verses.textEnNiv: When Mordecai learned of all that had been done, he tore his clothes, put on sackcloth and ashes, and went out into the city, wailing loudly and bitterly.
verses.textEnEsv: When Mordecai learned all that had been done, Mordecai tore his clothes and put on sackcloth and ashes, and went out into the midst of the city, and he cried out with a loud and bitter cry.
verses.textEnNkjv: When Mordecai learned all that had happened, he tore his clothes and put on sackcloth and ashes, and went out into the midst of the city. He cried out with a loud and bitter cry.
verses.textEnNlt: When Mordecai learned about all that had been done, he tore his clothes, put on burlap and ashes, and went out into the city, crying with a loud and bitter wail.
verses.textEnNasb: When Mordecai learned of everything that had been done, he tore his clothes, put on sackcloth and ashes, and went out into the midst of the city and wailed loudly and bitterly.
verses.textEn: When Mordecai learned of all that had been done, he tore his clothes, put on sackcloth and ashes, and went out into the city, wailing loudly and bitterly.

verses.textZh: 他到了御门前，就停住，因为身穿麻衣的，不可以进御门。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他到了御门前，就停住，因为身穿麻衣的，不可以进御门。
verses.textZhCuv: 到了朝门前停住脚步，因为穿麻衣的不可进朝门。
verses.textEnNiv: But he went only as far as the king’s gate, because no one clothed in sackcloth was allowed to enter it.
verses.textEnEsv: He went up to the entrance of the king’s gate, for no one was allowed to enter the king’s gate clothed in sackcloth.
verses.textEnNkjv: He went as far as the front of the king’s gate, for no one might enter the king’s gate clothed with sackcloth.
verses.textEnNlt: He went as far as the gate of the palace, for no one was allowed to enter the palace gate while wearing clothes of mourning.
verses.textEnNasb: And he came as far as the king’s gate, for no one was to enter the king’s gate clothed in sackcloth.
verses.textEn: But he went only as far as the king’s gate, because no one clothed in sackcloth was allowed to enter it.

verses.textZh: 王的谕旨和命令传到的各省各地，犹大人都大大悲哀，禁食、哭泣、悲伤；许多人披上麻衣，躺在灰尘中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 王的谕旨和命令传到的各省各地，犹大人都大大悲哀，禁食、哭泣、悲伤；许多人披上麻衣，躺在灰尘中。
verses.textZhCuv: 王的谕旨所到的各省各处，犹大人大大悲哀，禁食哭泣哀号，穿麻衣躺在灰中的甚多。
verses.textEnNiv: In every province to which the edict and order of the king came, there was great mourning among the Jews, with fasting, weeping and wailing. Many lay in sackcloth and ashes.
verses.textEnEsv: And in every province, wherever the king’s command and his decree reached, there was great mourning among the Jews, with fasting and weeping and lamenting, and many of them lay in sackcloth and ashes.
verses.textEnNkjv: And in every province where the king’s command and decree arrived, therewas great mourning among the Jews, with fasting, weeping, and wailing; and many lay in sackcloth and ashes.
verses.textEnNlt: And as news of the king’s decree reached all the provinces, there was great mourning among the Jews. They fasted, wept, and wailed, and many people lay in burlap and ashes.
verses.textEnNasb: In each and every province where the command and decree of the king came, there was great mourning among the Jews, with fasting, weeping, and mourning rites; and many had sackcloth and ashes spread out as a bed.
verses.textEn: In every province to which the edict and order of the king came, there was great mourning among the Jews, with fasting, weeping and wailing. Many lay in sackcloth and ashes.

verses.textZh: 以斯帖的婢女和太监把这事告诉以斯帖，王后就非常惊慌，就派人送衣服给末底改穿著，要他脱下麻衣，他却不接受。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以斯帖的婢女和太监把这事告诉以斯帖，王后就非常惊慌，就派人送衣服给末底改穿著，要他脱下麻衣，他却不接受。
verses.textZhCuv: 王后以斯帖的宫女和太监来把这事告诉以斯帖，她甚是忧愁，就送衣服给末底改穿，要他脱下麻衣，他却不受。
verses.textEnNiv: When Esther’s eunuchs and female attendants came and told her about Mordecai, she was in great distress. She sent clothes for him to put on instead of his sackcloth, but he would not accept them.
verses.textEnEsv: When Esther’s young women and her eunuchs came and told her, the queen was deeply distressed. She sent garments to clothe Mordecai, so that he might take off his sackcloth, but he would not accept them.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Esther’s maids and eunuchs came and told her, and the queen was deeply distressed. Then she sent garments to clothe Mordecai and take his sackcloth away from him, but he would not accept them.
verses.textEnNlt: When Queen Esther’s maids and eunuchs came and told her about Mordecai, she was deeply distressed. She sent clothing to him to replace the burlap, but he refused it.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Esther’s attendants and her eunuchs came and informed her, and the queen was seized by great fear. And she sent garments to clothe Mordecai so that he would remove his sackcloth from him, but he did not accept them.
verses.textEn: When Esther’s eunuchs and female attendants came and told her about Mordecai, she was in great distress. She sent clothes for him to put on instead of his sackcloth, but he would not accept them.

verses.textZh: 以斯帖就把王派来侍候她的一个太监哈他革召了来，吩咐他到末底改那里去，探听这是甚么一回事，又是为了甚么缘故。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以斯帖就把王派来侍候她的一个太监哈他革召了来，吩咐他到末底改那里去，探听这是甚么一回事，又是为了甚么缘故。
verses.textZhCuv: 以斯帖就把王所派伺候她的一个太监，名叫哈他革召来，吩咐他去见末底改，要知道这是什么事，是什么缘故。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Esther summoned Hathak, one of the king’s eunuchs assigned to attend her, and ordered him to find out what was troubling Mordecai and why.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Esther called for Hathach, one of the king’s eunuchs, who had been appointed to attend her, and ordered him to go to Mordecai to learn what this was and why it was.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Esther called Hathach, one of the king’s eunuchs whom he had appointed to attend her, and she gave him a command concerning Mordecai, to learn what and why this was.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Esther sent for Hathach, one of the king’s eunuchs who had been appointed as her attendant. She ordered him to go to Mordecai and find out what was troubling him and why he was in mourning.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Esther summoned Hathach from the king’s eunuchs, whom the king had appointed to attend her, and ordered him to go to Mordecai to learn what this mourning was and why it was happening.
verses.textEn: Then Esther summoned Hathak, one of the king’s eunuchs assigned to attend her, and ordered him to find out what was troubling Mordecai and why.

verses.textZh: 于是哈他革出到御门前的广场去见末底改。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是哈他革出到御门前的广场去见末底改。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是哈他革出到朝门前的宽阔处见末底改。
verses.textEnNiv: So Hathak went out to Mordecai in the open square of the city in front of the king’s gate.
verses.textEnEsv: Hathach went out to Mordecai in the open square of the city in front of the king’s gate,
verses.textEnNkjv: So Hathach went out to Mordecai in the city square that was in front of the king’s gate.
verses.textEnNlt: So Hathach went out to Mordecai in the square in front of the palace gate.
verses.textEnNasb: So Hathach went out to Mordecai in the city square, in front of the king’s gate.
verses.textEn: So Hathak went out to Mordecai in the open square of the city in front of the king’s gate.

verses.textZh: 末底改把他遭遇的一切事，以及哈曼为灭尽犹大人答应捐银给王库的数目，都告诉了他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 末底改把他遭遇的一切事，以及哈曼为灭尽犹大人答应捐银给王库的数目，都告诉了他。
verses.textZhCuv: 末底改将自己所遇的事，并哈曼为灭绝犹大人应许捐入王库的银数都告诉了他；
verses.textEnNiv: Mordecai told him everything that had happened to him, including the exact amount of money Haman had promised to pay into the royal treasury for the destruction of the Jews.
verses.textEnEsv: and Mordecai told him all that had happened to him, and the exact sum of money that Haman had promised to pay into the king’s treasuries for the destruction of the Jews.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Mordecai told him all that had happened to him, and the sum of money that Haman had promised to pay into the king’s treasuries to destroy the Jews.
verses.textEnNlt: Mordecai told him the whole story, including the exact amount of money Haman had promised to pay into the royal treasury for the destruction of the Jews.
verses.textEnNasb: Mordecai told him everything that had happened to him, and the exact amount of money that Haman had promised to pay to the king’s treasuries for the elimination of the Jews.
verses.textEn: Mordecai told him everything that had happened to him, including the exact amount of money Haman had promised to pay into the royal treasury for the destruction of the Jews.

verses.textZh: 末底改又把在书珊城颁布要毁灭犹大人的谕旨抄本，交给了哈他革，要他给以斯帖看，并且要给她说明，吩咐她进宫见王，向王求情，为自己的族人在王面前恳求。
verses.textZhCnvs: 末底改又把在书珊城颁布要毁灭犹大人的谕旨抄本，交给了哈他革，要他给以斯帖看，并且要给她说明，吩咐她进宫见王，向王求情，为自己的族人在王面前恳求。
verses.textZhCuv: 又将所抄写传遍书珊城要灭绝犹大人的旨意交给哈他革，要给以斯帖看，又要给她说明，并嘱咐她进去见王，为本族的人在王面前恳切祈求。
verses.textEnNiv: He also gave him a copy of the text of the edict for their annihilation, which had been published in Susa, to show to Esther and explain it to her, and he told him to instruct her to go into the king’s presence to beg for mercy and plead with him for her people.
verses.textEnEsv: Mordecai also gave him a copy of the written decree issued in Susa for their destruction, that he might show it to Esther and explain it to her and command her to go to the king to beg his favor and plead with him on behalf of her people.
verses.textEnNkjv: He also gave him a copy of the written decree for their destruction, which was given at Shushan, that he might show it to Esther and explain it to her, and that he might command her to go in to the king to make supplication to him and plead before him for her people.
verses.textEnNlt: Mordecai gave Hathach a copy of the decree issued in Susa that called for the death of all Jews. He asked Hathach to show it to Esther and explain the situation to her. He also asked Hathach to direct her to go to the king to beg for mercy and plead for her people.
verses.textEnNasb: He also gave him a copy of the text of the edict which had been issued in Susa for their annihilation, so that he might show Esther and inform her, and to order her to go in to the king to implore his favor and plead with him for her people.
verses.textEn: He also gave him a copy of the text of the edict for their annihilation, which had been published in Susa, to show to Esther and explain it to her, and he told him to instruct her to go into the king’s presence to beg for mercy and plead with him for her people.

verses.textZh: 哈他革回来，把末底改的话都告诉了以斯帖。
verses.textZhCnvs: 哈他革回来，把末底改的话都告诉了以斯帖。
verses.textZhCuv: 哈他革回来，将末底改的话告诉以斯帖；
verses.textEnNiv: Hathak went back and reported to Esther what Mordecai had said.
verses.textEnEsv: And Hathach went and told Esther what Mordecai had said.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Hathach returned and told Esther the words of Mordecai.
verses.textEnNlt: So Hathach returned to Esther with Mordecai’s message.
verses.textEnNasb: So Hathach came back and reported Mordecai’s words to Esther.
verses.textEn: Hathak went back and reported to Esther what Mordecai had said.

verses.textZh: 以斯帖把以下的话告诉哈他革，又吩咐他回复末底改说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 以斯帖把以下的话告诉哈他革，又吩咐他回复末底改说：

verses.textEnEsv: Then Esther spoke to Hathach and commanded him to go to Mordecai and say,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Esther spoke to Hathach, and gave him a command for Mordecai:
verses.textEnNlt: Then Esther told Hathach to go back and relay this message to Mordecai:
verses.textEnNasb: Then Esther spoke to Hathach and ordered him to reply to Mordecai:
verses.textEn: Then she instructed him to say to Mordecai,

verses.textZh: "王所有的臣仆和各省的人民，都知道有一条法令：无论男女，没有奉召就擅入内院去见王的，除非王向他伸出金杖，赐他免死，一律要处以死刑。现在我没有奉召进去见王已经三十天了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: "王所有的臣仆和各省的人民，都知道有一条法令：无论男女，没有奉召就擅入内院去见王的，除非王向他伸出金杖，赐他免死，一律要处以死刑。现在我没有奉召进去见王已经三十天了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 「王的一切臣仆和各省的人民都知道有一个定例：若不蒙召，擅入内院见王的，无论男女必被治死；除非王向他伸出金杖，不得存活。现在我没有蒙召进去见王已经三十日了。」
verses.textEnNiv: "All the king’s officials and the people of the royal provinces know that for any man or woman who approaches the king in the inner court without being summoned the king has but one law: that they be put to death unless the king extends the gold scepter to them and spares their lives. But thirty days have passed since I was called to go to the king."
verses.textEnEsv: "All the king’s servants and the people of the king’s provinces know that if any man or woman goes to the king inside the inner court without being called, there is but one law—to be put to death, except the one to whom the king holds out the golden scepter so that he may live. But as for me, I have not been called to come in to the king these thirty days."
verses.textEnNkjv: "All the king’s servants and the people of the king’s provinces know that any man or woman who goes into the inner court to the king, who has not been called, hehas but one law: put all to death, except the one to whom the king holds out the golden scepter, that he may live. Yet I myself have not been called to go in to the king these thirty days."
verses.textEnNlt: "All the king’s officials and even the people in the provinces know that anyone who appears before the king in his inner court without being invited is doomed to die unless the king holds out his gold scepter. And the king has not called for me to come to him for thirty days."
verses.textEnNasb: "All the king’s servants and the people of the king’s provinces know that for any man or woman who comes to the king in the inner courtyard, who is not summoned, he has only one law, that he be put to death, unless the king holds out to him the golden scepter so that he may live. And I have not been summoned to come to the king for these thirty days."
verses.textEn: "All the king’s officials and the people of the royal provinces know that for any man or woman who approaches the king in the inner court without being summoned the king has but one law: that they be put to death unless the king extends the gold scepter to them and spares their lives. But thirty days have passed since I was called to go to the king."

verses.textZhCnvs: 哈他革把以斯帖的话都告诉末底改。

verses.textZh: 末底改叫人回复以斯帖说："你不要心里想，你在王宫里比所有的犹大人都安全。
verses.textZhCnvs: 末底改叫人回复以斯帖说："你不要心里想，你在王宫里比所有的犹大人都安全。
verses.textZhCuv: 末底改托人回复以斯帖说：「你莫想在王宫里强过一切犹大人，得免这祸。
verses.textEnNiv: he sent back this answer: "Do not think that because you are in the king’s house you alone of all the Jews will escape.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Mordecai told them to reply to Esther, "Do not think to yourself that in the king’s palace you will escape any more than all the other Jews.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Mordecai told them to answer Esther: "Do not think in your heart that you will escape in the king’s palace any more than all the other Jews.
verses.textEnNlt: Mordecai sent this reply to Esther: "Don’t think for a moment that because you’re in the palace you will escape when all other Jews are killed.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Mordecai told them to reply to Esther, "Do not imagine that you in the king’s palace can escape any more than all the other Jews.
verses.textEn: he sent back this answer: "Do not think that because you are in the king’s house you alone of all the Jews will escape.

verses.textZh: 这时你若是缄默不言，犹大人必会从别的地方得着解救，那时你和你的父家就必灭亡。谁知你得了王后的位分，不是为了挽救现今的危机吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 这时你若是缄默不言，犹大人必会从别的地方得着解救，那时你和你的父家就必灭亡。谁知你得了王后的位分，不是为了挽救现今的危机吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 此时你若闭口不言，犹大人必从别处得解脱，蒙拯救；你和你父家必致灭亡。焉知你得了王后的位分不是为现今的机会吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: For if you remain silent at this time, relief and deliverance for the Jews will arise from another place, but you and your father’s family will perish. And who knows but that you have come to your royal position for such a time as this?"
verses.textEnEsv: For if you keep silent at this time, relief and deliverance will rise for the Jews from another place, but you and your father’s house will perish. And who knows whether you have not come to the kingdom for such a time as this?"
verses.textEnNkjv: For if you remain completely silent at this time, relief and deliverance will arise for the Jews from another place, but you and your father’s house will perish. Yet who knows whether you have come to the kingdom for such a time as this?"
verses.textEnNlt: If you keep quiet at a time like this, deliverance and relief for the Jews will arise from some other place, but you and your relatives will die. Who knows if perhaps you were made queen for just such a time as this?"
verses.textEnNasb: For if you keep silent at this time, liberation and rescue will arise for the Jews from another place, and you and your father’s house will perish. And who knows whether you have not attained royalty for such a time as this?"
verses.textEn: For if you remain silent at this time, relief and deliverance for the Jews will arise from another place, but you and your father’s family will perish. And who knows but that you have come to your royal position for such a time as this?"

verses.textZh: "你要去，把书珊城所有的犹大人都召集起来，为我禁食三天，就是三日三夜不吃不喝；我和我的婢女也要这样禁食。然后我就违例进去见王；我若是死，就死吧。"
verses.textZhCnvs: "你要去，把书珊城所有的犹大人都召集起来，为我禁食三天，就是三日三夜不吃不喝；我和我的婢女也要这样禁食。然后我就违例进去见王；我若是死，就死吧。"
verses.textZhCuv: 「你当去招聚书珊城所有的犹大人，为我禁食三昼三夜，不吃不喝；我和我的宫女也要这样禁食。然后我违例进去见王，我若死就死吧！」
verses.textEnNiv: "Go, gather together all the Jews who are in Susa, and fast for me. Do not eat or drink for three days, night or day. I and my attendants will fast as you do. When this is done, I will go to the king, even though it is against the law. And if I perish, I perish."
verses.textEnEsv: "Go, gather all the Jews to be found in Susa, and hold a fast on my behalf, and do not eat or drink for three days, night or day. I and my young women will also fast as you do. Then I will go to the king, though it is against the law, and if I perish, I perish."
verses.textEnNkjv: "Go, gather all the Jews who are present in Shushan, and fast for me; neither eat nor drink for three days, night or day. My maids and I will fast likewise. And so I will go to the king, which is against the law; and if I perish, I perish!"
verses.textEnNlt: "Go and gather together all the Jews of Susa and fast for me. Do not eat or drink for three days, night or day. My maids and I will do the same. And then, though it is against the law, I will go in to see the king. If I must die, I must die."
verses.textEnNasb: "Go, gather all the Jews who are found in Susa, and fast for me; do not eat or drink for three days, night or day. I and my attendants also will fast in the same way. And then I will go in to the king, which is not in accordance with the law; and if I perish, I perish."
verses.textEn: "Go, gather together all the Jews who are in Susa, and fast for me. Do not eat or drink for three days, night or day. I and my attendants will fast as you do. When this is done, I will go to the king, even though it is against the law. And if I perish, I perish."

verses.textZh: 于是末底改离开了，照着以斯帖吩咐的一切去行。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是末底改离开了，照着以斯帖吩咐的一切去行。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是末底改照以斯帖一切所吩咐的去行。
verses.textEnNiv: So Mordecai went away and carried out all of Esther’s instructions.
verses.textEnEsv: Mordecai then went away and did everything as Esther had ordered him.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Mordecai went his way and did according to all that Esther commanded him.
verses.textEnNlt: So Mordecai went away and did everything as Esther had ordered him.
verses.textEnNasb: So Mordecai went away and did just as Esther had commanded him.
verses.textEn: So Mordecai went away and carried out all of Esther’s instructions.

verses.textZh: 第三天，以斯帖穿上朝服，站在王宫的内院，对着王殿；王在殿里坐在王位上，对着殿门。
verses.textZhCnvs: 第三天，以斯帖穿上朝服，站在王宫的内院，对着王殿；王在殿里坐在王位上，对着殿门。
verses.textZhCuv: 第三日，以斯帖穿上朝服，进王宫的内院，对殿站立。王在殿里坐在宝座上，对着殿门。
verses.textEnNiv: On the third day Esther put on her royal robes and stood in the inner court of the palace, in front of the king’s hall. The king was sitting on his royal throne in the hall, facing the entrance.
verses.textEnEsv: On the third day Esther put on her royal robes and stood in the inner court of the king’s palace, in front of the king’s quarters, while the king was sitting on his royal throne inside the throne room opposite the entrance to the palace.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it happened on the third day that Esther put on her royal robes and stood in the inner court of the king’s palace, across from the king’s house, while the king sat on his royal throne in the royal house, facing the entrance of the house.
verses.textEnNlt: On the third day of the fast, Esther put on her royal robes and entered the inner court of the palace, just across from the king’s hall. The king was sitting on his royal throne, facing the entrance.
verses.textEnNasb: Now it came about on the third day that Esther put on her royal robes and stood in the inner courtyard of the king’s palace in front of the king’s rooms, and the king was sitting on his royal throne in the throne room, opposite the entrance to the palace.
verses.textEn: On the third day Esther put on her royal robes and stood in the inner court of the palace, in front of the king’s hall. The king was sitting on his royal throne in the hall, facing the entrance.

verses.textZh: 王见王后以斯帖站在院内，就对她施恩，向她伸出手中的金杖，以斯帖就上前摸杖头。
verses.textZhCnvs: 王见王后以斯帖站在院内，就对她施恩，向她伸出手中的金杖，以斯帖就上前摸杖头。
verses.textZhCuv: 王见王后以斯帖站在院内，就施恩于她，向她伸出手中的金杖；以斯帖便向前摸杖头。
verses.textEnNiv: When he saw Queen Esther standing in the court, he was pleased with her and held out to her the gold scepter that was in his hand. So Esther approached and touched the tip of the scepter.
verses.textEnEsv: And when the king saw Queen Esther standing in the court, she won favor in his sight, and he held out to Esther the golden scepter that was in his hand. Then Esther approached and touched the tip of the scepter.
verses.textEnNkjv: So it was, when the king saw Queen Esther standing in the court, that she found favor in his sight, and the king held out to Esther the golden scepter that was in his hand. Then Esther went near and touched the top of the scepter.
verses.textEnNlt: When he saw Queen Esther standing there in the inner court, he welcomed her and held out the gold scepter to her. So Esther approached and touched the end of the scepter.
verses.textEnNasb: When the king saw Esther the queen standing in the courtyard, she obtained favor in his sight; and the king extended to Esther the golden scepter which was in his hand. So Esther approached and touched the top of the scepter.
verses.textEn: When he saw Queen Esther standing in the court, he was pleased with her and held out to her the gold scepter that was in his hand. So Esther approached and touched the tip of the scepter.

verses.textZh: 王问她："王后以斯帖啊，你有甚么事吗？你求甚么？就是一半江山，也必赐给你。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 王问她："王后以斯帖啊，你有甚么事吗？你求甚么？就是一半江山，也必赐给你。"
verses.textZhCuv: 王对她说：「王后以斯帖啊，你要什么？你求什么，就是国的一半也必赐给你。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then the king asked, "What is it, Queen Esther? What is your request? Even up to half the kingdom, it will be given you."
verses.textEnEsv: And the king said to her, "What is it, Queen Esther? What is your request? It shall be given you, even to the half of my kingdom."
verses.textEnNkjv: And the king said to her, "What do you wish, Queen Esther? What is your request? It shall be given to you—up to half the kingdom!"
verses.textEnNlt: Then the king asked her, "What do you want, Queen Esther? What is your request? I will give it to you, even if it is half the kingdom!"
verses.textEnNasb: Then the king said to her, "What is troubling you, Queen Esther? And what is your request? Up to half of the kingdom it shall be given to you."
verses.textEn: Then the king asked, "What is it, Queen Esther? What is your request? Even up to half the kingdom, it will be given you."

verses.textZh: 以斯帖回答："王若是欢喜，就请王今天带着哈曼来赴我为王预备的筵席。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 以斯帖回答："王若是欢喜，就请王今天带着哈曼来赴我为王预备的筵席。"
verses.textZhCuv: 以斯帖说：「王若以为美，就请王带着哈曼今日赴我所预备的筵席。」
verses.textEnNiv: "If it pleases the king," replied Esther, "let the king, together with Haman, come today to a banquet I have prepared for him."
verses.textEnEsv: And Esther said, "If it please the king, let the king and Haman come today to a feast that I have prepared for the king."
verses.textEnNkjv: So Esther answered, "If it pleases the king, let the king and Haman come today to the banquet that I have prepared for him."
verses.textEnNlt: And Esther replied, "If it please the king, let the king and Haman come today to a banquet I have prepared for the king."
verses.textEnNasb: Esther said, "If it pleases the king, may the king and Haman come this day to the banquet that I have prepared for him."
verses.textEn: "If it pleases the king," replied Esther, "let the king, together with Haman, come today to a banquet I have prepared for him."

verses.textZh: 王说："快把哈曼召来，好照着以斯帖的话去行。"于是王带着哈曼去赴以斯帖预备的筵席。
verses.textZhCnvs: 王说："快把哈曼召来，好照着以斯帖的话去行。"于是王带着哈曼去赴以斯帖预备的筵席。
verses.textZhCuv: 王说：「叫哈曼速速照以斯帖的话去行。」于是王带着哈曼赴以斯帖所预备的筵席。
verses.textEnNiv: "Bring Haman at once," the king said, "so that we may do what Esther asks." So the king and Haman went to the banquet Esther had prepared.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the king said, "Bring Haman quickly, so that we may do as Esther has asked." So the king and Haman came to the feast that Esther had prepared.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the king said, "Bring Haman quickly, that he may do as Esther has said." So the king and Haman went to the banquet that Esther had prepared.
verses.textEnNlt: The king turned to his attendants and said, "Tell Haman to come quickly to a banquet, as Esther has requested." So the king and Haman went to Esther’s banquet.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the king said, "Bring Haman quickly so that we may do as Esther desires." So the king and Haman came to the banquet which Esther had prepared.
verses.textEn: "Bring Haman at once," the king said, "so that we may do what Esther asks." So the king and Haman went to the banquet Esther had prepared.

verses.textZh: 在酒席中，王问以斯帖："你要甚么？我必赐给你；你求甚么？就是一半江山，也必为你成全。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 在酒席中，王问以斯帖："你要甚么？我必赐给你；你求甚么？就是一半江山，也必为你成全。"
verses.textZhCuv: 在酒席筵前，王又问以斯帖说：「你要什么，我必赐给你；你求什么，就是国的一半也必为你成就。」
verses.textEnNiv: As they were drinking wine, the king again asked Esther, "Now what is your petition? It will be given you. And what is your request? Even up to half the kingdom, it will be granted."
verses.textEnEsv: And as they were drinking wine after the feast, the king said to Esther, "What is your wish? It shall be granted you. And what is your request? Even to the half of my kingdom, it shall be fulfilled."
verses.textEnNkjv: At the banquet of wine the king said to Esther, "What is your petition? It shall be granted you. What is your request, up to half the kingdom? It shall be done!"
verses.textEnNlt: And while they were drinking wine, the king said to Esther, "Now tell me what you really want. What is your request? I will give it to you, even if it is half the kingdom!"
verses.textEnNasb: As they drank their wine at the banquet, the king said to Esther, "What is your request, for it shall be granted to you. And what is your wish? Up to half of the kingdom it shall be done."
verses.textEn: As they were drinking wine, the king again asked Esther, "Now what is your petition? It will be given you. And what is your request? Even up to half the kingdom, it will be granted."

verses.textZh: 以斯帖回答说："我所要我所求的就是：
verses.textZhCnvs: 以斯帖回答说："我所要我所求的就是：
verses.textZhCuv: 以斯帖回答说：「我有所要，我有所求。
verses.textEnNiv: Esther replied, "My petition and my request is this:
verses.textEnEsv: Then Esther answered, "My wish and my request is:
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Esther answered and said, "My petition and request isthis:
verses.textEnNlt: Esther replied, "This is my request and deepest wish.
verses.textEnNasb: So Esther replied, "My request and my wish is:
verses.textEn: Esther replied, "My petition and my request is this:

verses.textZh: 我若是在王眼前蒙恩，王若是愿意赐给我所要的，成全我所求的，就请王带着哈曼明天再来赴我为你们预备的筵席；明天我必照着王的命令行。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我若是在王眼前蒙恩，王若是愿意赐给我所要的，成全我所求的，就请王带着哈曼明天再来赴我为你们预备的筵席；明天我必照着王的命令行。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我若在王眼前蒙恩，王若愿意赐我所要的，准我所求的，就请王带着哈曼再赴我所要预备的筵席。明日我必照王所问的说明。」
verses.textEnNiv: If the king regards me with favor and if it pleases the king to grant my petition and fulfill my request, let the king and Haman come tomorrow to the banquet I will prepare for them. Then I will answer the king’s question."
verses.textEnEsv: If I have found favor in the sight of the king, and if it please the king to grant my wish and fulfill my request, let the king and Haman come to the feast that I will prepare for them, and tomorrow I will do as the king has said."
verses.textEnNkjv: If I have found favor in the sight of the king, and if it pleases the king to grant my petition and fulfill my request, then let the king and Haman come to the banquet which I will prepare for them, and tomorrow I will do as the king has said."
verses.textEnNlt: If I have found favor with the king, and if it pleases the king to grant my request and do what I ask, please come with Haman tomorrow to the banquet I will prepare for you. Then I will explain what this is all about."
verses.textEnNasb: if I have found favor in the sight of the king, and if it pleases the king to grant my request and do what I wish, may the king and Haman come to the banquet which I will prepare for them, and tomorrow I will do as the king says."
verses.textEn: If the king regards me with favor and if it pleases the king to grant my petition and fulfill my request, let the king and Haman come tomorrow to the banquet I will prepare for them. Then I will answer the king’s question."

verses.textZh: 那天哈曼心里快乐，高高兴兴地出来；但是哈曼见了末底改在御门那里不站起来，也不因哈曼的缘故而退避，哈曼心里就对末底改充满忿怒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那天哈曼心里快乐，高高兴兴地出来；但是哈曼见了末底改在御门那里不站起来，也不因哈曼的缘故而退避，哈曼心里就对末底改充满忿怒。
verses.textZhCuv: 那日哈曼心中快乐，欢欢喜喜地出来；但见末底改在朝门不站起来，连身也不动，就满心恼怒末底改。
verses.textEnNiv: Haman went out that day happy and in high spirits. But when he saw Mordecai at the king’s gate and observed that he neither rose nor showed fear in his presence, he was filled with rage against Mordecai.
verses.textEnEsv: And Haman went out that day joyful and glad of heart. But when Haman saw Mordecai in the king’s gate, that he neither rose nor trembled before him, he was filled with wrath against Mordecai.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Haman went out that day joyful and with a glad heart; but when Haman saw Mordecai in the king’s gate, and that he did not stand or tremble before him, he was filled with indignation against Mordecai.
verses.textEnNlt: Haman was a happy man as he left the banquet! But when he saw Mordecai sitting at the palace gate, not standing up or trembling nervously before him, Haman became furious.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Haman went out that day joyful and pleased of heart; but when Haman saw Mordecai at the king’s gate and that he did not stand up or tremble before him, Haman was filled with anger against Mordecai.
verses.textEn: Haman went out that day happy and in high spirits. But when he saw Mordecai at the king’s gate and observed that he neither rose nor showed fear in his presence, he was filled with rage against Mordecai.

verses.textZh: 哈曼忍住怒气，回家去了，就派人去请他的朋友和妻子细利斯来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 哈曼忍住怒气，回家去了，就派人去请他的朋友和妻子细利斯来。
verses.textZhCuv: 哈曼暂且忍耐回家，叫人请他朋友和他妻子细利斯来。
verses.textEnNiv: Nevertheless, Haman restrained himself and went home. Calling together his friends and Zeresh, his wife,
verses.textEnEsv: Nevertheless, Haman restrained himself and went home, and he sent and brought his friends and his wife Zeresh.
verses.textEnNkjv: Nevertheless Haman restrained himself and went home, and he sent and called for his friends and his wife Zeresh.
verses.textEnNlt: However, he restrained himself and went on home. Then Haman gathered together his friends and Zeresh, his wife,
verses.textEnNasb: Haman controlled himself, however, and went to his house. But he sent for his friends and his wife Zeresh.
verses.textEn: Nevertheless, Haman restrained himself and went home. Calling together his friends and Zeresh, his wife,

verses.textZh: 哈曼把他的富贵荣华、儿女的众多，以及王怎样使他尊大，怎样抬举他在王的众领袖和众臣仆之上的一切事，都数说给他们听。
verses.textZhCnvs: 哈曼把他的富贵荣华、儿女的众多，以及王怎样使他尊大，怎样抬举他在王的众领袖和众臣仆之上的一切事，都数说给他们听。
verses.textZhCuv: 哈曼将他富厚的荣耀、众多的儿女，和王抬举他使他超乎首领臣仆之上，都述说给他们听。
verses.textEnNiv: Haman boasted to them about his vast wealth, his many sons, and all the ways the king had honored him and how he had elevated him above the other nobles and officials.
verses.textEnEsv: And Haman recounted to them the splendor of his riches, the number of his sons, all the promotions with which the king had honored him, and how he had advanced him above the officials and the servants of the king.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Haman told them of his great riches, the multitude of his children, everything in which the king had promoted him, and how he had advanced him above the officials and servants of the king.
verses.textEnNlt: and boasted to them about his great wealth and his many children. He bragged about the honors the king had given him and how he had been promoted over all the other nobles and officials.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Haman told them of the glory of his riches, and his many sons, and every occasion on which the king had honored him and how he had promoted him above the officials and servants of the king.
verses.textEn: Haman boasted to them about his vast wealth, his many sons, and all the ways the king had honored him and how he had elevated him above the other nobles and officials.

verses.textZh: 哈曼又说："王后以斯帖除我以外，没有邀请别人与王一同去赴她预备的筵席；明天又邀请我与王一同到她那里去赴席。
verses.textZhCnvs: 哈曼又说："王后以斯帖除我以外，没有邀请别人与王一同去赴她预备的筵席；明天又邀请我与王一同到她那里去赴席。
verses.textZhCuv: 哈曼又说：「王后以斯帖预备筵席，除了我之外不许别人随王赴席。明日王后又请我随王赴席；
verses.textEnNiv: "And that’s not all," Haman added. "I’m the only person Queen Esther invited to accompany the king to the banquet she gave. And she has invited me along with the king tomorrow.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Haman said, "Even Queen Esther let no one but me come with the king to the feast she prepared. And tomorrow also I am invited by her together with the king.
verses.textEnNkjv: Moreover Haman said, "Besides, Queen Esther invited no one but me to come in with the king to the banquet that she prepared; and tomorrow I am again invited by her, along with the king.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Haman added, "And that’s not all! Queen Esther invited only me and the king himself to the banquet she prepared for us. And she has invited me to dine with her and the king again tomorrow!"
verses.textEnNasb: Haman also said, "Even Esther the queen let no one except me come with the king to the banquet which she had prepared; and tomorrow also I am invited by her with the king.
verses.textEn: "And that’s not all," Haman added. "I’m the only person Queen Esther invited to accompany the king to the banquet she gave. And she has invited me along with the king tomorrow.

verses.textZh: 只是每逢我看见坐在朝门那里的犹大人末底改的时候，这一切对我都没有多大的意思。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 只是每逢我看见坐在朝门那里的犹大人末底改的时候，这一切对我都没有多大的意思。"
verses.textZhCuv: 只是我见犹大人末底改坐在朝门，虽有这一切荣耀，也与我无益。」
verses.textEnNiv: But all this gives me no satisfaction as long as I see that Jew Mordecai sitting at the king’s gate."
verses.textEnEsv: Yet all this is worth nothing to me, so long as I see Mordecai the Jew sitting at the king’s gate."
verses.textEnNkjv: Yet all this avails me nothing, so long as I see Mordecai the Jew sitting at the king’s gate."
verses.textEnNlt: Then he added, "But this is all worth nothing as long as I see Mordecai the Jew just sitting there at the palace gate."
verses.textEnNasb: Yet all of this does not satisfy me every time I see Mordecai the Jew sitting at the king’s gate."
verses.textEn: But all this gives me no satisfaction as long as I see that Jew Mordecai sitting at the king’s gate."

verses.textZh: 他的妻子细利斯和他所有的朋友都对他说："叫人立一个二十二公尺高的木架，明早求王，把末底改挂在上面，然后你可以欢欢喜喜地与王一同赴筵席了。"这话使哈曼很满意，就叫人做了木架。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的妻子细利斯和他所有的朋友都对他说："叫人立一个二十二公尺高的木架，明早求王，把末底改挂在上面，然后你可以欢欢喜喜地与王一同赴筵席了。"这话使哈曼很满意，就叫人做了木架。
verses.textZhCuv: 他的妻细利斯和他一切的朋友对他说：「不如立一个五丈高的木架，明早求王将末底改挂在其上，然后你可以欢欢喜喜地随王赴席。」哈曼以这话为美，就叫人做了木架。
verses.textEnNiv: His wife Zeresh and all his friends said to him, "Have a pole set up, reaching to a height of fifty cubits, and ask the king in the morning to have Mordecai impaled on it. Then go with the king to the banquet and enjoy yourself." This suggestion delighted Haman, and he had the pole set up.
verses.textEnEsv: Then his wife Zeresh and all his friends said to him, "Let a gallows fifty cubits high be made, and in the morning tell the king to have Mordecai hanged upon it. Then go joyfully with the king to the feast." This idea pleased Haman, and he had the gallows made.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then his wife Zeresh and all his friends said to him, "Let a gallows be made, fifty cubits high, and in the morning suggest to the king that Mordecai be hanged on it; then go merrily with the king to the banquet." And the thing pleased Haman; so he had the gallows made.
verses.textEnNlt: So Haman’s wife, Zeresh, and all his friends suggested, "Set up a sharpened pole that stands seventy-five feet tall, and in the morning ask the king to impale Mordecai on it. When this is done, you can go on your merry way to the banquet with the king." This pleased Haman, and he ordered the pole set up.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Zeresh his wife and all his friends said to him, "Have a wooden gallows fifty cubits high made, and in the morning ask the king to have Mordecai hanged on it; then go joyfully with the king to the banquet." And the advice pleased Haman, so he had the wooden gallows made.
verses.textEn: His wife Zeresh and all his friends said to him, "Have a pole set up, reaching to a height of fifty cubits, and ask the king in the morning to have Mordecai impaled on it. Then go with the king to the banquet and enjoy yourself." This suggestion delighted Haman, and he had the pole set up.
